correctness.rationale: For an alphabet of 3 letters, each constant length-k scattered subsequence forces >=k copies per letter so min length is 3k. Rich-block (arch) greedy decomposition forces k consecutive permutation triples at minimal length; circular rotation permits exactly three phase classes. Their sizes 6^k, pair intersections 3*2^k and triple intersection 6 yield L_k=3*6^k-9*2^k+6, and exactly one/two/three counts follow by inclusion-exclusion. A fixed nonmultiple-of-3 rotation would permute all phases and hence force a period-3 word, contradiction; rotations by 3j fix L_gcd(k,j) words. Burnside gives the stated N_k and Möbius inversion gives primitive necklaces. k=1 phase collapse is covered by formulas. Independent enumeration of all 3^(3k) words for k=1..4, explicit subsequence checks for k<=3, checked L_k, phase multiplicities, necklaces and primitive counts; general result proven structurally.
